task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: To remove only BOX_MIDDLE from the stack, we must first remove BOX_TOP (since only the top of the stack can be picked), place it temporarily on TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally put BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is currently on top of BOX_MIDDLE, which is on top of BOX_BOTTOM - forming a stack.
Only the topmost box in the stack can be picked at any time (stack discipline).
TEMP_TABLE is used as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP.
The robot CAR can navigate to all relevant locations and interact within its interaction_distance of 2.0.
Navigation tolerance of 1.0 is sufficient to be within interaction_distance of the objects.
